title: 3D Surveying Tripod and Level
description: Detailed procedural 3D tripod and level with explicit instrument height, spatial sight axis, surveying azimuth, and sight elevation.
learningObjectives: Identify the optical-axis height and major components of a mounted level.
Interpret surveying azimuth clockwise from north and sight elevation in the LearnMat 3D coordinate basis.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat procedural geometry; no third-party models or textures.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as real Three.js instrument geometry. Sight-vector convention source-reviewed; live rendered/browser/accessibility evidence remains pending.

source.reference: Reserved surveying queue task sur-tripod-level; 3D remediation of merged PR #8.
